Origin: board DM msg 272 (2026-08-31), Forrest: 'let's get a favicon for our chat when we can. easier to find in the tabs.' Acked in DM msg 275 with a commitment to file it through the normal loop — this is that task.

Scope hint: a simple, distinctive mark is fine — no purchase, no external assets, nothing fancy. Serve it from apps/chat/public/ (note: server.js serves statics via the explicit STATIC_FILES allowlist map, so the icon needs an entry there) and wire it in index.html via <link rel="icon">. An inline SVG-as-favicon or small hand-made .svg/.png is fine. Goal is purely tab findability.
data.title: Chat: favicon for the chat app

Honest note on the queue: at one lifecycle stage per tick, a chore this small still costs plan + implement + review ticks, which is why it has sat — the cost is the lifecycle, not the work.
Board directive (DM msg 394): all chat issues ship. Cluster order 6/6 — favicon last; ships with the cluster, not before it.

Chat cluster re-ordered 2026-09-03 (cto-owen, board DM msg 519). Order: AS-27 (planned) -> AS-75 (merge-to-deploy gap, high) -> AS-28 (this) -> AS-73 -> AS-74 -> AS-72 -> AS-61. Rationale for AS-75 ahead of the favicon: four merged chat tasks are not live in the container; nothing here is 'shipped' in the board's sense until merges deploy. Still assigned to Marcus as default internal-tools implementer; Lena may take it under lane doctrine if Marcus is on the D1 spine.

QA review (qa-priya, cold, cycle 1) of feat/AS-28-favicon @ 8ee82bf (1 commit, 4 files, +62; author developer-lena in the actor-id form). Inputs: plan, git diff master...feat/AS-28-favicon, BRANDING.md §5/§3.1, the running server from the worktree. Not read before findings: review_state/, any other actor's scratchpad, implementer comments. Scratch copy for mutants: scratchpad/agent-qa-priya/AS-28/scratch (worktree never mutated; git -C .worktrees/AS-28 diff --exit-code clean at 8ee82bf after the review).

FINDINGS (3 outside the criteria list; 1 blocking)

F1 [BLOCKING, implementation-level] AC-3's palette guard examines the wrong set: its regex /#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}/g matches the two hex strings inside the SVG's XML comment (line 4) as well as the four paint attributes, and it matches any 6-hex prefix rather than a whole paint value. Two mutants on the scratch copy SURVIVED (suite 370/370 green both times; site assertions confirm each landed on SVG lines 5-8, so these are guard gaps, not wrong-site mutations):
- M3c: fill="#1C41E3" -> fill="red", all three circles fill="#FFFFFF" -> fill="lime", comment intact -> 0 red. The cardinality floor (found.length >= 2) is satisfied by the comment's '#1C41E3 = --color-accent-500, #FFFFFF = --color-ink-white', so an artwork with zero palette colors passes 'uses only palette hex values' — the exact vacuous-pass shape the floor was written to prevent (plan §Tests: 'an SVG with no colors at all cannot pass vacuously').
- M3d: fill="#1C41E3" -> fill="#1C41E3FF" (8-digit hex with alpha) -> 0 red; the regex takes the first six digits and accepts it. #F00, rgb(...), and named colors are unmatched for the same reason.
The SVG itself is correct (both paints are the two tokens); the defect is the guard. Rework, test-only, in test/api.test.js: strip XML comments before matching; collect every paint value (fill=, stroke=, stop-color=, and style= if ever present) as whole attribute values; cardinality floor = paint attributes examined >= 4 (this artwork has 1 path + 3 circles); every value must equal one of the two tokens case-insensitively as a whole value. Add to AC-3, with observed reds required: M3c (named colors, comment intact) and M3d (#1C41E3FF), alongside the plan's M3a/M3b which must stay red.

F2 [non-blocking, record] M1 (drop the STATIC_FILES entry) reddened 2 tests, not the 1 the plan predicted: 'served with the SVG content type' AND 'uses only palette hex values' (the latter fetches /favicon.svg, gets the 404 JSON body, and the cardinality floor fires on 0 hex). Coupling through the route, not a defect; recorded because a set that differs from the prediction is itself a finding.

F3 [non-blocking, backlog if anyone cares] Content-type is image/svg+xml with no charset, unlike every neighbouring STATIC_FILES entry (; charset=utf-8). The plan specified it this way and the file is 100% ASCII (0 non-ASCII bytes of 593), so nothing depends on it; consistency only. Not changed.

Pre-existing behaviours observed while probing, outside this task's scope, not findings against it: HEAD /favicon.svg -> 404 (STATIC_FILES is GET-only for every static); //favicon.svg -> 200 text/html (WHATWG parses //x as a host, pathname /, so index.html — true of //anything).

SWEEP — floor check (AC-1..5), every mutant on the scratch copy, anchored to the site, applied (bytes asserted changed), restored byte-equal:
- AC-1 served: PASS. GET /favicon.svg -> 200, Content-Type: image/svg+xml, CSP default-src 'self', no-store, 593 bytes (plan cap 600), starts <svg, viewBox 0 0 32 32. M1 (delete server.js L40 entry) -> RED SET (2): {api: AS-28 — /favicon.svg is served with the SVG content type; api: AS-28 — the favicon uses only palette hex values}. Entry is load-bearing.
- AC-2 wired: PASS. Served / contains the exact link line. M2 (delete index.html L8) -> RED SET (1): {api: AS-28 — index.html links the favicon}.
- AC-3 palette-only: PASS ON THE LETTER, FAILS ON ITS STATED PURPOSE (F1). M3a (L5 fill -> #FF0000) -> RED SET (1): {api: AS-28 — the favicon uses only palette hex values}. M3b (strip every hex: comment L4 + fills L5-8 -> none) -> RED SET (1): same test (cardinality floor). Probes M3c/M3d: 0 red each — survivors.
- AC-4 suite: HOST PASS, COMPOSE OWED. HOST master baseline (main checkout, node --test): 367 tests, 0 fail. HOST worktree: 370 tests, 0 fail = baseline + 3. Scratch copy unmutated: 370/370. Counted compose run (DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=1 /usr/local/bin/docker compose run --rm --build test; binary path from deploy-state.json) was DENIED at the permission layer in this headless session — no 'Image … Built' line, no compose number quoted, receipt still owed before done per the plan (AS-92).
- AC-5 nothing else moved: PASS. --stat = exactly favicon.svg (+9), index.html (+1), server.js (+1), api.test.js (+51); no JS, so the Escape chain and every element id in index.html are untouched by construction (the index.html diff is one <link> line). 'public' is in IMAGE_INPUTS (advance-watcher.mjs L78) and the Dockerfile COPYs it, so the AS-75 watcher redeploys with no compose/Dockerfile change — the plan's claim holds.
Sweep: 5 of 5 on the letter; findings outside the list: 3 (1 blocking).

PROBE LEDGER (M6)
- Path variants, raw socket: /favicon.svg/../favicon.svg, /../favicon.svg, /%2e%2e/favicon.svg, /./favicon.svg -> all normalized by WHATWG URL to /favicon.svg and answered 200 by the allowlist (exact-key map; the filename comes from the map, not the URL). /favicon%2Esvg, /favicon%2esvg, /FAVICON.SVG, /favicon.svg/, /public/favicon.svg, /%2Ffavicon.svg, /favicon.svg%00, /__proto__, /constructor, /favicon.ico -> 404 JSON from the allowlist. The AS-34 file gate never answers: /api/file?path=apps/chat/public/favicon.svg -> 404 'No such file.' byte-identical to a nonexistent path (no .md suffix); favicon.svg.md and index.html likewise.
- SVG content: read in full (9 lines). Only xmlns; no script, foreignObject, href/xlink, style, use, image, event attributes, no strokes (fill-only). role=img aria-label='ASC Chat' matches the page <title>; a favicon is not in the accessibility tree and 'ASC' is not rendered, so BRANDING §5.3's abbreviation rule is not engaged. No lettering, no monogram: the 'tab marker, not a brand mark' framing holds in the artifact.
- 16 px static geometry (viewBox 32, scale 0.5): body 14x10.5 px, corner r 2 px, tail 3.5x3 px, dots d 2.5 px with a 1.0 px edge gap — the tightest feature; at 16 px with antialiasing the three dots may fuse into a bar. WCAG contrast: dots on fill 7.20:1; fill on light chrome 6.47-7.20:1; fill on dark chrome 1.58-2.37:1 (luminance; hue still separates, and the white dots carry ~15:1 against dark chrome). VISUAL CHECK NOT PERFORMED: no browser in a headless tick. Owed alongside the compose receipt from a session with a screen, or accepted as-is by the CTO.
- Merge seam with AS-99 (feat/AS-99-lane-view @ 971d6a1): git merge-tree, git apply --check, patch --dry-run, and git merge-file were all denied here, so this is reasoned from git diff -U0 ranges plus a context check, not an observed merge. server.js: AS-99 inserts /lanes.js after master L37 (AS-99 L49), AS-28 inserts after L39 — two unchanged lines between the insertion points, and AS-28's anchor (the /style.css line followed by '};') is present exactly once, unchanged, in AS-99's file (L51-52); index.html: AS-99 after L18/L115, AS-28 after L7 — AS-28's 6-line context appears exactly once, unchanged, in AS-99's file; api.test.js: AS-99 touches L10 and L1181+, AS-28 inserts after L1169 — context likewise present once and unchanged. Expect a clean merge; the second-to-merge still rebases and re-runs per the plan.
- Zero external calls, zero spend, no new deps (package.json untouched, zero-dependency app).

VERDICT: implementation-level rework needed — F1 only (test-only change to AC-3's guard, with M3c/M3d added as named falsifiers). Everything else passes on the letter. Owed regardless of F1 before done: the counted docker compose run --rm --build test receipt (Image Built line) and the light/dark tab render check, both from a session that has docker and a browser. Chat: #engineering msg 697.

REVIEW CYCLE 1 → REWORK (orchestrator cto-owen, loop tick 6). Following Priya's verdict: implementation-level rework, test-only. Findings appended to the plan under '## Review Cycle 1 Findings'. Lena (next tick) hardens the AC-3 palette guard in test/api.test.js — strip XML comments, match whole paint-attribute values, floor on paint attributes examined — and adds M3c/M3d as named falsifiers observed red, on feat/AS-28-favicon inside .worktrees/AS-28. SVG, allowlist entry and link line stand. Compose --build receipt and the tab render check still owed.

REWORK CYCLE 1 STARTED (orchestrator cto-owen, loop tick 7 / watcher:76266). Lena resumes in .worktrees/AS-28 on feat/AS-28-favicon from 8ee82bf: test-only rework of the AC-3 palette guard in test/api.test.js per Priya's F1 — strip XML comments before matching, match whole fill=/stroke= paint values against the allowed set, floor on paint attributes examined (>=4), add M3c (fills red/lime with comment intact) and M3d (8-digit hex fill) as named falsifiers each observed red on a scratch copy. SVG, allowlist entry and link line stand. Plan §'Review Cycle 1 Findings' is the brief. Compose --build receipt and tab render check remain owed. Parallel lane: AS-99 rework (Marcus).

IMPLEMENTATION REWORK DONE (agent:developer-lena, loop tick 7 / watcher:76266). Cycle-1 F1 only; test-only, one file. Commit 2c96c27 on feat/AS-28-favicon (parent 8ee82bf), worktree clean, tree diff master...HEAD = the same 4 files (api.test.js now +73).

FINDINGS FIRST
- F-mine (harness, not the guard): my first mutation run reported ALL EIGHT mutants as survivors at 'tests=null exit=1'. The suites had in fact run and failed correctly — my harness parsed TAP ('not ok N - name') while node --test emits the spec reporter here ('i tests N' / a trailing 'x failing tests:' section), so it read zero red everywhere. A vacuous harness is indistinguishable from a vacuous guard from the outside; the tell was 'tests=null' (cardinality before quantification). Harness now asserts the summary counts parsed AND that the number of failing names it extracted equals the suite's own fail count, and throws rather than report a red set it does not understand. Worth knowing for anyone scripting mutants against this suite.
- F1 fixed. The guard now: (1) strips XML comments from the served SVG before matching, so the comment's '#1C41E3 = --color-accent-500, #FFFFFF = --color-ink-white' can no longer satisfy the floor by itself; (2) collects WHOLE paint-attribute values via /\b(fill|stroke|stop-color|flood-color|lighting-color)\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"/g and requires each trimmed, lowercased value to equal a palette token — so '#1C41E3FF', '#F00', 'red', 'rgb(...)' all fail; (3) floors on PAINT ATTRIBUTES EXAMINED >= 4 (one path + three circles), not hex occurrences; (4) asserts the artwork carries no <style> element and no style="" attribute, because those are the two remaining doors a colour could enter through without passing (2) — if the icon ever needs CSS, the guard learns to parse it in the same change. Deliberately strict: 'none' is NOT in the allowed set, since this artwork is solid-fill only; a future designer adding fill="none" gets a red and a decision, not a silent pass.
- F2 confirmed, not changed: M1's red set is 2 tests (the palette test fetches /favicon.svg and its floor fires on the 404 body) — same coupling Priya recorded, now visible as '0 paint attributes examined, expected at least 4'.
- F3 (no charset on image/svg+xml) untouched, as instructed.
- Proposed AC-3 wording for the plan (metawork/orchestrator applies; I do not edit .lattice/): 'AC-3 palette-only. Every whole paint-attribute value in the served SVG, XML comments excluded, is a palette token, and >= 4 paint attributes are examined. Falsifiers, each an observed red: M3a fill -> #FF0000; M3b every 6-hex stripped file-wide; M3c fills -> red/lime with the comment intact; M3d fill -> #1C41E3FF; M3e every paint attribute removed (floor); M3f style="fill:red" added with palette fills intact.'

NUMBERS
Host suite (node --test from .worktrees/AS-28/apps/chat): 370 tests / 370 pass / 0 fail, before and after — the rework adds no test, it fixes the one that existed. Cycle-1 baseline was 370/370 (master 367/367).

MUTANTS — 8 run, 8 applied at the intended site, 0 survivors. Each on a fresh 'cp -R' scratch copy of apps/chat under /tmp/as28-mutants/<id>; the worktree was never mutated (git status clean throughout, verified at commit).
| mutant | site (asserted) | red set observed |
| M1 | server.js L40 '/favicon.svg' STATIC_FILES entry deleted; neighbour L39 /style.css asserted still present | 2: 'served with the SVG content type' + 'uses only palette hex values' (370/368/2) |
| M2 | index.html L8 <link rel="icon"> deleted; stylesheet link asserted still present | 1: 'index.html links the favicon' (370/369/1) |
| M3a | favicon.svg L5 '<path fill="#1C41E3"' -> '#FF0000'; comment asserted intact | 1: palette (370/369/1) |
| M3b | favicon.svg: all six 6-hex occurrences stripped file-wide -> fill=""; emptied path fill asserted | 1: palette (370/369/1) |
| M3c | favicon.svg L5-8 path->fill="red", 3 circles->fill="lime"; comment asserted BYTE-INTACT and no hex paint left | 1: palette (370/369/1) — the cycle-1 survivor, now red |
| M3d | favicon.svg L5 '<path fill="#1C41E3FF"'; comment asserted intact | 1: palette (370/369/1) — the cycle-1 survivor, now red |
| M3e | favicon.svg: all 4 fill attributes removed; path geometry and comment asserted intact | 1: palette, via the floor (370/369/1) |
| M3f | favicon.svg L5 style="fill:red" added to <path>, 3 palette circles asserted unchanged | 1: palette, via the no-style assertion (370/369/1) |

data.body:
QA review (qa-priya, cold, CYCLE 2) of feat/AS-28-favicon @ 2c96c27 (rework commit test-only, +73 in test/api.test.js; favicon.svg, index.html, server.js byte-identical to cycle 1). Inputs: plan incl. reworded AC-3, the diff, the worktree server booted in-process, my own cycle-1 findings. Order kept: findings formed and enumerated before I read the implementer rework comment; I read that comment afterwards (05:1xZ) to compare, and it agrees with my numbers on every point (8/8 red, M3c/M3d red, HOST 370/370, compose denied in her tick). Not read: review_state/, the auto-review artifact, other actors scratchpads. Scratch copy for every mutant: scratchpad/agent-qa-priya/AS-28/cycle2/scratch (worktree never mutated; git -C .worktrees/AS-28 diff --exit-code clean at 2c96c27 after everything; scratch restored byte-equal after each mutant).

FINDINGS FIRST (F1 closed; 2 new low-severity gaps recorded, neither blocks; 2 records; 1 discovered issue out of scope)

F1 (cycle-1 blocker) CLOSED, observed: M3c (fills -> red/lime, XML comment intact) RED on "the favicon uses only palette hex values" with message "4 paint attributes examined: fill=\"red\" is not a palette token"; M3d (fill -> #1C41E3FF) RED, same test. P4 (comment rewritten to carry fill="#1C41E3" fill="#FFFFFF", one real paint removed) RED via the floor at 3 - comment text no longer counts toward cardinality. Comment stripping, whole-value matching and the paint-attribute floor all do what the rework says.

F4 [LOW, non-blocking, M6 probe] Single-quoted paint attributes are invisible to the guard. Its regex reads only double-quoted values (\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"). Mutant P1: add stroke="#1C41E3" to the path (palette, counted) and repaint one circle with fill=’red’ (ASCII single quotes in the actual mutant) -> 370/370 GREEN, survivor. Re-read of the mutated file confirms both edits at lines 5 and 6, and an independent both-quote-style scan sees the red value: a guard gap, not a wrong-site mutation. P1b (the single-quoted fill alone) goes red only because the count drops to 3 - coincidence of the floor, not detection. Why it does not block: AC-3 names six falsifiers (M3a-f) and all six are observed red; under M4 the property sentence beyond the named falsifiers is documentation; the input needs a mixed-quote edit in a uniformly double-quoted 9-line file plus an extra paint, which is not the careless single edit the guard exists to catch (every single-edit variant I ran - named colour, 3/6/8-digit hex, style attr, style element, comment smuggling, removed paints - is red). Fix is one alternation, (?:"([^"]*)"|’([^’]*)’) with value = dq ?? sq, plus P1 as a named falsifier. Not applied inline: it changes the guard behaviour and I do not verify my own patch. Recommend a small follow-up (orchestrator to file or accept).

F5 [LOW, non-blocking, exotic] SMIL repaint door: <set attributeName="fill" to="red"/> inside the path -> 370/370 GREEN (P3 survivor). Not a paint attribute, not a style, so the guard never sees it. Whether a browser honours SMIL when rasterizing a favicon is NOT verified here (no browser). Fix would be one assertion that the artwork carries no <set|animate|animateColor> element. Same follow-up as F4.

F6 [record] The guard rejects correct artwork that uses fill="none" (P6: a wrapping <g fill="none"> -> RED) and the short spelling #fff (P7 -> RED). Safe direction (false red), matches the rework stated intent (strict allowed set; widening the artwork means widening the set in the same change). No action.
F7 [record] fill-opacity="0" on the path passes (P5 survivor) - visibility is outside AC-3 palette claim; noted only to bound what the guard proves.
F3 (cycle 1, cosmetic charset-less content-type) unchanged, still not changed. F2 coupling (M1 reds 2 tests) reproduced identically.

D1 [discovered, OUT OF AS-28 SCOPE - filed as a backlog task by me] The docker daemon on this host carries 26 leftover asc-* compose networks from earlier review/lane scratch projects (asc-as93-ruben-mac1..9, asc-as93-mutant, asc-as94-lena/ruben, asc-as95-qa*, asc-marcus95, asc-qa-ruben-as75, asc-chat-qa23, ...). My first master-baseline compose run failed with "all predefined address pools have been fully subnetted"; downing my own project freed a subnet and the retry passed. I removed nothing that is not mine.

SWEEP - floor check, 5 of 5 (mutants: 19 run, all site-asserted on the scratch copy, 14 red, 5 survivors of which 2 are the gaps above and 3 are expected greens)
- AC-1 served: PASS. Live: 200, Content-Type image/svg+xml, Cache-Control no-store, CSP default-src self; 593 bytes, sha256 1ed7df06766ea066 == on-disk file, 0 non-ASCII bytes. M1 (server.js L40 entry deleted) -> RED SET (2): served-with-SVG-content-type, palette (cycle-1 F2 coupling).
